warnings: 被排除的稳定期 NDT 位姿仍明显变化；固定跳过次数不保证已稳定收敛。相对 RMSE 和 Δe 依赖该变化中的对齐窗口，正式段按预定规则完整保留。

initialization.interpretation: Correction from a manual coarse seed; excluded from stability accuracy metrics. Its absolute correctness is not determined by this experiment.

alignment.scope: One fixed planar transform from excluded settling pairs only. Shared by T_init/T_ndt/T_final. No scale fit or formal-trajectory refit.

map_odom_reference.definition: Variation about excluded settling map->odom state center; not a mocap ground-truth error

final_pose_definition: Localizer-internal final base_link state at the cloud timestamp, not the publication-time pose. The odom TF bridge planarizes raw sensor roll/pitch, whereas the internal localizer uses full 3D extrinsics; do not call them exactly identical.

mocap_formal.definition: Descriptive centered scatter only; not a separate reference alignment or absolute accuracy

mocap_settling.definition: Descriptive centered scatter only; not a separate reference alignment or absolute accuracy

ndt_final_settling.definition: Descriptive centered scatter only; not a separate reference alignment or absolute accuracy

lio_reconstructed_formal.definition: Descriptive centered scatter only; not a separate reference alignment or absolute accuracy

static_verification.lio_note: O = inverse(pre-NDT map->odom) * T_init, using the same recorded cloud-time odometry; algebraic reconstruction, not an independent sensor.

ndt_net_effect_all.interpretation: e_raw - e_initial against the shared excluded-settling alignment; improvement/worsening is conditional on that reference, not absolute truth

ndt_net_effect_accepted.interpretation: e_raw - e_initial against the shared excluded-settling alignment; improvement/worsening is conditional on that reference, not absolute truth

propagation.definition: T_init_next = M_post_current * O_next when state is inherited. Contributions use full SE(3); report vector components because scalar norms cannot be added.

interpretation: Relative stability after initialization. Large NDT updates are not necessarily incorrect. Net improvement is conditional on the fixed settling alignment; no absolute accuracy or guaranteed local-minimum diagnosis.

tf_chain_audit.definition: Final NDT map->odom state composed with recorded odom->base_link at/near each input-cloud stamp; compared with the internal final_at_cloud pose.
tf_chain_audit.scope: Formal-phase unique NDT input-cloud measurements only
tf_chain_audit.duplicate_timestamp_policy: Last recorded sample retained; conflicting planar transforms counted explicitly
tf_chain_audit.initialpose_audit_note: Topic absent from the bag means unavailable evidence, not proof that no seed was sent. Counts do not establish which node accepted each seed.
tf_chain_audit.geometry_implementation_note: Current localizer uses full 3D FAST-LIO sensor-to-base composition; lio_tf_to_base_tf.py emits yaw-only base rotation and planar XY extrinsic compensation. This audit quantifies the resulting difference without changing either implementation.
limitations: This is an independent geometry audit, not mocap ground-truth accuracy.
The final map->odom state is selected from that match; NDT completion and TF publication happen later. These are not actual map->base TF values broadcast at the earlier cloud timestamp.
Nearest odom TF is allowed only within the configured skew; nonzero skew can contribute temporal differences.
Recorded /tf does not identify the publishing node; conflicting publishers cannot be ruled out solely from message contents.

tracker_to_base_applied.notes: User-confirmed 2026-10-15: Tracker0 rigid-body origin is directly above the ROS base_link origin by 0.18 m; both axes are X-forward, Y-left, Z-up.  This is T_Tracker0_base_link=(0,0,-0.18 m), identity rotation. The separate evaluation path must apply it before comparing against map->base_link; this passive receiver never publishes a base_link pose or TF.
